template: raes-library-template
version: 1
id: parameterized-scenario
surface: scenario
requirement_refs:
- AUT-806
source_refs:
- docs/explain/sdl/sections.md
- docs/explain/sdl/validation.md
summary: Scenario template whose host operating system, size, instance count, and
  service port come from declared variables.
validation:
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen python tools/check_example_library.py
  expected: Exits 0 with no output. The gate reads this file with the sdl-yaml/v1
    loader, which rejects duplicate keys and merge keys. It parses the body with the
    SDL parser and semantic validator, which reject a placeholder that names an undeclared
    variable, and fails on any error or advisory.
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen raes semantic validate
    my-scenario.sdl.yaml
  expected: 'With the body saved as my-scenario.sdl.yaml, prints "validate: success"
    and exits 0. This command does not report semantic-validator advisories.'
body:
  name: library-parameterized-template
  description: Scenario whose host operating system, size, instance count, and service
    port come from declared variables with defaults.
  variables:
    web_os:
      type: string
      default: linux
      allowed_values:
      - linux
      - windows
      description: Operating system of each web host.
    web_ram:
      type: string
      default: 1 GiB
      description: Memory for each web host.
    web_cpu:
      type: integer
      default: 1
      description: CPU count for each web host.
    web_count:
      type: integer
      default: 2
      description: Number of web hosts.
    https_port:
      type: integer
      default: 443
      description: Port of the HTTPS service on each web host.
  nodes:
    app-net:
      type: switch
    web:
      type: compute
      os: ${web_os}
      resources:
        ram: ${web_ram}
        cpu: ${web_cpu}
      services:
      - port: ${https_port}
        protocol: tcp
        name: https
  infrastructure:
    app-net:
      count: 1
      properties:
        cidr: 10.30.0.0/24
        gateway: 10.30.0.1
        internal: true
    web:
      count: ${web_count}
      links:
      - app-net
name: changed
